bannerText: Muse X Poster: bài đã điền sẵn (đã bỏ tag Binance). Bấm Post trên X để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Muse X Poster v1.4: fill the post LINE BY LINE (one insertText per line, insertParagraph between lines) instead of a single multi-line insertText, which mangled the post in X's Draft.js editor (the last line got duplicated ~18 times and the body was lost). v1.3's focused-editor selection, replace-instead-of-append, and fail-on-mismatch checks are unchanged.
